changelog: Shotgun MAGs: GTDB naming of the bins was the slow step (sourmash multigather read the whole GTDB database once per bin — about half an hour for the 8 Zymo bins on nextapp). The bins are now merged for one prefetch pass over GTDB, and the per-bin gather runs on the genomes that pass keeps; same names, about 4x faster in the test, more with more bins. The job page now names each MAG step (assembling, depth, binning, CheckM2, Kraken 2 naming, GTDB, AMRFinderPlus) instead of 'assembly and binning' throughout. Includes 2.20.1 (Nanopore bins).

previous.changelog: Shotgun MAGs, Nanopore: no bins were formed although Flye assembled the Zymo mock into 173 contigs (N50 668 kb). jgi_summarize_bam_contig_depths counts only reads >= 97 % identical to a contig by default, which drops most Nanopore reads (about 93 % here), so contig depth was ~0 and MetaBAT 2 had no target contigs. Nanopore runs now count reads >= 80 % identical (Illumina unchanged, 97 %). When no bins form, the report says why. Backend restart not required (pipeline file only).
